name: S3Dc GPU Decompression and Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that compresses volume data on the CPU into a Minimum/Maximum Value (MMV) texture and an Index Value (IV) texture, then decompresses and renders the volume directly on the GPU using fragment shaders, avoiding CPU-GPU transfer bottlenecks.
summary: S3Dc is a lossy volume compression algorithm that enables direct GPU rendering of scalar data by storing compressed MinMax and Index volumes, avoiding block artifacts common in standard texture formats.
